relation: the natural weight of a finite set, sum of the supplied natural weights of its members, with upstream GraphTheory.core.dom.weight_set w S := \sum_(v in S) w v canonical: GTMisc X128 x128_weight, Minor X190 x190_weight, Minor X199 x199_weight and GTMisc U13 gold_total are its body at T := G (the same binder and argument order) and are transparent aliases of it, related by conversion. Any finite carrier, any natural weights (zero weights included) and any set (the empty set weighs 0); no positivity hypothesis. GTBase.set_weights bridges it to the event and total weights fg_event_weight w [in S] and fg_total_weight w of GTBase.finite_graph, whose ratio predicates keep their own positive-total-weight guards.
summary: Batch A, family A30 (finite-set weights), on the accepted parent P' 3bdfdae. The four local weights GTMisc X128 x128_weight, Minor X190 x190_weight, Minor X199 x199_weight and GTMisc U13 gold_total ((G : sgraph) (w : G -> nat) (S : {set G}) : nat := \sum_(v in S) w v; U13's alpha-equivalent copy found by the body scan) are upstream GraphTheory.core.dom.weight_set at T := G and become transparent aliases of it. No summation primitive is added: GTBase.set_weights gives positivity-free views (empty set 0, singleton, whole carrier = fg_total_weight, constant weights c * #|S|, disjoint additivity, complement split, monotonicity, zero test, pointwise extensionality) and the finite-set coercion bridge weight_set w S = fg_event_weight w [in S]. Public client base/theories/examples/set_weights.v.

Frozen verbatim at P': the four sources, the separator and game-value chains (x128_cheap_bal_sep, x190_strongly_sublinear_separator_class, x199_weighted_balanced_separator and its constant-M variant, leaf_game_solution) and four complete rows: X128 (p before q, individual-graph expansion hypothesis, 1 <= t, at most q t outliers, t-times cheapness, two-times connected-part balance), X190 (0 < a < b, exponent bound, weighted balance; identity-cover vacuity blocked), X199 (bound before ell >= 1, cardinality bounds, weighted balance; class/quantifier/bound defects blocked) and U13's gold-grabbing game (nonempty tree, Bellman recursion with truncated subtraction). X128's deepest Original combines C16's complete A7+C16 Original expansion chain with the A30 frozen separator and weight. Fourteen certificates, all conversions except the Original's whole-chain composition.

Proof consumers: grounding_U13's gold_total_set0 and leaf_game_E1 add one unfold of the public weight; the X128 history certificates of edge_count, ambient_shallow_minors and ambient_grad and the rest of the reverse closure recompile byte-exact. Separator contracts, polynomial evaluation and graph encodings stay distinct.

distinct_variants.name: match_weight
distinct_variants.note: an integer product of signs over a perfect matching; not a set weight

distinct_variants.name: coloring_weight
distinct_variants.note: an integer sum of matching weights over colour-compatible matchings; not a set weight
